description: List the vaulted payment methods (credit cards, PayPal accounts, etc.) for one customer, by GraphQL global Customer ID. Returns each method's id, legacyId, usage, created-at, and detail type. GraphQL `node { ... on Customer { paymentMethods } }`.

first.description: Max payment methods to return. Default 50.

name: braintree_customer_payment_methods
title: List a customer's payment methods
